release_notes: The paid-traffic release. Spend import from seven push & pop networks — AdMaven, PropellerAds, Kadam, Galaxion (per campaign × zone) and HilltopAds, Adsterra, Clickadu (per campaign) — in a new Push/Pop networks card (⚙ → Integrations), with honest zone attribution: a zone row lands only on clicks carrying both the zone id and the network campaign id. Zone Killer: per-campaign rules that surface — and in auto mode block through the network's API — the zones burning money; dry-run by default, with a block journal and Telegram notifications. Social link preview: messenger preview bots get your og:* card, humans are routed as always. Conversion popups now live in each campaign (editor → Popup tab): template, live preview, four steps; Settings → Plugins is the overview and the template; kclient.php injects the popup itself, no code line needed. Conversion notifications no longer arrive twice: a repeat postback with the same status is still stored but stays silent.
